description:
Taptico is a quiet set of metallic fidget toys for iPhone — real clicks, pops, and slides from the Taptic Engine. No ads. No account. Three toys free forever.

Stay focused at a desk, wind down at night, or just enjoy oddly satisfying ASMR-style taps. Every module is a small gold-and-steel object you can actually feel.

FREE FOREVER
• Combination Lock — spin the dial and feel every detent
• Toggle Switches — heavy industrial snaps
• Magnetic Slider — drag until it snaps to either end

LIFETIME UNLOCK
One purchase, priced by Apple for your region. Opens every module, gold themes, and Desk Stand mode:
• Desk Cube — analog stick, gear, worry stone, clicker dots
• Infinity Cube — fold eight cubes that stay in one piece
• Clicker Pen — a retractable click with a writing tip
• Metal Spinner, Zipper, and Dimple pop-it plate
• Bearing Chamber, Key Matrix, and Ambient Pad

Built as a sensory focus tool, not a medical app. No subscriptions. Restore Purchases is always on the paywall.
promotional_text: Quiet metallic fidget toys with real iPhone haptics. Cube, spinner, zipper, pop-it. Three free. No ads. One-time lifetime unlock.

in_app_purchases.description: Unlock all modules, premium themes, and Desk Stand mode forever.

review_notes:
Thank you for reviewing Taptico. Please use a physical iPhone (haptics and tilt do not work in Simulator).

WHAT IT IS
A 4+ sensory fidget / focus toy. It is not a medical, therapy, or diagnostic app and does not claim to treat ADHD, anxiety, or any condition. No user accounts, no chat, no user-generated content, no ads, no subscriptions.

NO LOGIN
Leave the demo account fields blank. The app is fully usable immediately.

HOW TO REVIEW (about 1 minute)
1. Launch the app. Swipe between modules on the home carousel.
2. Free modules (no purchase): Combination Lock, Toggle Switches, Magnetic Slider. Please try at least one.
3. Tap a premium module (for example Desk Cube, Spinner, or Clicker Pen). The paywall appears.
4. Or tap Premium (crown / unlock control) at the top of the home screen.

IN-APP PURCHASE
Product: Lifetime Unlock
Type: Non-consumable (one-time, not auto-renewing)
Product ID: com.orehruoy.taptico.lifetime
Price: StoreKit localized price from App Store Connect (not hardcoded)
What it unlocks: remaining modules, premium themes, Desk Stand mode
Buy: paywall button labeled Get Premium
Restore Purchases: on the same paywall, labeled Restore. Guideline 3.1.1 is met; there is no other payment method.
Please attach this IAP to the binary when submitting.

AUDIO
Ambient Pad (premium) is a musical instrument-style pad. It uses AVAudioSessionCategoryPlayback so sound can continue when the hardware Ring/Silent switch is on, like a music app. Other modules use short UI clicks only.

OTHER
Privacy policy: https://orehruoy.github.io/Taptico/privacy.html
Analytics: Firebase Analytics only (product usage). No advertising, no IDFA, no ATT prompt.
Optional “Enjoying Taptico?” sheet may appear after three unique calendar days. Yes = standard SKStoreReviewController. No = optional feedback form (message + optional email). Users can dismiss it.
Support: support@orehruoy.com

Please approve Lifetime Unlock together with the app. Thank you.
